{{RaceIcon|SpawnBronze|Male}}{{RaceIcon|SpawnBronze|Female}} [[Dragonspawn]] | capital = [[Caverns of Time]] | theater = [[Azeroth]] | language = [[Draconic]], [[Common (language)|Common]] | affiliation = Independent | status = Active }} The '''bronze dragonflight''' is a draconic organization led by the eponymous [[bronze dragon]]s to uphold their creed of managing and watching over the flow of magic on Azeroth. After the ordering of the planet, the titan [[Aman'Thul]] blessed [[Nozdormu]] and his flight with the power to guard time itself and police the ever-spinning pathways of fate and destiny.[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Charge_of_the_Dragonflights Charge of the Dragonflights] ==Culture== ===Nomenclature=== Members of the bronze dragonflight occasionally have names ending in "dormu" for males, or "dormi" for females, though [[Chronormu|exceptions]] exist. Sometimes terms relating to time find their way into their names as well. ===Membership=== The bronze dragonflight is primarily made up of, as the name implies, bronze dragonkin. These include the bronze dragons themselves, but also bronze-scaled variants of drakonid and dragonspawn. ==History== ===The Charge of the Dragonflights=== Once the [[Titan]]s felt satisfied with their creation upon [[Azeroth]], they left to roam the cosmos in search of new worlds on which they would shape order from chaos, creating new life throughout a myriad of worlds. Before their departure from Azeroth however, the Titans empowered five dragons to become stewards of that world. Their purpose: to guard Azeroth as the Dragon Aspects, protecting the Titans' creation. [[Aman'Thul]], the Highfather of the [[Pantheon]], bestowed a portion of his cosmic power upon the massive bronze dragon, Nozdormu. The Highfather empowered Nozdormu to guard time itself and police the ever-spinning pathways of fate and destiny. The stoic, honorable Nozdormu became known as the Timeless One. ===War of the Ancients=== ===After the Sundering=== ===Battle of Grim Batol=== ===Third War=== ===World of Warcraft=== ==References== {{reflist}} [[Category:Bronze dragonflight]] [[Category:Lore]]
